environment.title: Title of the dialog that lists environments (named sets of variables such as Staging or Production).
environment.active: Label of the picker that chooses which environment requests use.
environment.noEnvironment: Picker option meaning no environment is used.
environment.shared: Badge for an environment available to every collection.
environment.availableIn: Label of a field that limits an environment to one collection.
environment.everyCollection: Option meaning the environment is not limited to one collection.
environment.inCollection: {{name}} is an environment name, {{collection}} the collection that owns it.
environment.followedFor: Tooltip. {{name}} is an environment name, {{collection}} a collection name.
environment.colour: Label of the colour picker for an environment.
environment.globalsTab: Tab label for global variables that are shared by all collections.
environment.dotEnv: Tab label. A .env file holds environment variables for processes. Keep the file name.
environment.inherits: Label of a field that picks a parent environment whose variables are used as defaults.
environment.search: Placeholder and accessible label of a filter field.
environment.enabled: Accessible label of a checkbox that switches one variable on or off.
environment.secret: Accessible label of a button that marks a variable value as secret (hidden, kept apart from files).
environment.notSecret: Accessible label of a button that shows the value is not secret.
environment.looksLikeCredential: Warning under a variable whose value resembles a password, token or key. A button next to it marks the variable as secret.
environment.reveal: Accessible label of a button that shows a hidden value.
environment.hide: Accessible label of a button that hides a value.
environment.nameRequired: Short validation message under a variable name field.
environment.isActive: Badge on the environment currently in use.
environment.stopUsing: Button that stops using the active environment.
environment.precedence: Order in which variable scopes override each other. Keep the scope names consistent with the other labels.
environment.promptTitle: Title of the dialog that asks for values at send time.
environment.promptSend: Button that sends the request after values are entered.
environment.promptContinue: Button that continues a paused run.
environment.scriptGlobals: Heading for global variables in the script help.
environment.sessionValues: Heading for variables kept only in memory during this session.
color.names.gray: Colour name in the palette for environments.
color.customValue: {{hex}} is a colour code such as #aabbcc. Keep it unchanged.
environment.defaultName: Name given to the first environment created automatically when none exists. Saved as the environment name.
environment.value: Column heading: the value of a variable.
environment.valueLines: Tooltip of the value field: Shift+Enter is a keyboard shortcut and stays as written.
environment.openEditor: Tooltip and accessible name of the button on a variable value that opens the value in a larger editor window.
environment.editorTitle: Title of the larger editor window for one variable value. {{name}} is the variable name and stays as written.
environment.documentType: Accessible label of the switch between Text, JSON and XML in the value editor window; it sets syntax colours, checking and the Format action.
environment.formatTitle: Tooltip of Format in the value editor window. {{type}} is JSON or XML, {{chord}} is a keyboard shortcut such as Shift+Alt+F, and {{example}} is the literal text {{variables}}. All three stay as written.
environment.viewLabel: Accessible label of the switch between editing variables as a table and as text.
environment.viewTable: Switch option: edit variables as table rows.
environment.viewText: Switch option: edit variables as plain text, one per line.
environment.textLabel: Accessible label of the text box that holds all variables, one per line.
environment.textPlaceholder: Placeholder showing the line format. Keep NAME and the equals sign.
environment.textNote: Explains the text format. NAME=value is literal syntax.
environment.heldRows: Notice below the text box. {{count}} is the number of variables the text box cannot show.
